about: RULES.md 1.4: the performance gate (packaging/dexterity/tests/perf_gate.py) fails a build over any of these. Measured on 28 Oct 2026 on an office laptop (DirectX 12 GPU): startup 1.5 s, idle 212 MB in use (486 MB reserved, mostly by the graphics driver), idle CPU 0, typing 17-33 ms, 2 million cells open in 3.6 s using 371 MB, scrolling them 27 ms per frame, 0-10 MB kept after closing. The GitHub runner (release 1.2.0, 27 Oct 2026): exe 37.3 MB, startup 0.5 s, idle 121 MB, idle CPU 0, typing 33 ms, 2 million cells in 1.1 s using 303 MB, scrolling 25 ms, 21 MB kept. Budgets sit about 1.5-2x above the slower of the two. Raise a budget only with a reason written here.

exe_mb.why: 37.3 MB; a jump means a dependency or asset bloated it

startup_ms.why: 1.5 s on a laptop, 0.5 s on the runner

idle_ram_mb.why: 212 MB on a laptop, 121 MB on the runner

idle_cpu_ms_per_10s.why: 0 on both: the window draws only when something changes

open_big_ms.why: 3.6 s for 2 million cells on a laptop, 1.1 s on the runner

big_ram_mb.why: 371 MB with 2 million cells open on a laptop, 303 MB on the runner

leak_after_close_mb.why: memory not given back after closing the big workbook: 0-10 MB on a laptop, 21 MB on the runner
